currentRoundInspection.scope: Four integral surviving monumental entrance piers only, placed on their four actual mapped footprints. Model low broad irregular rubble bodies, fractured tops and a taller narrow eastern wall remnant from the ordinary official entrance photograph. Three passages, lawn and paths remain open. No intact triumphal arches, reconstructed lintels, entrance roof or invented paved platform. Main villa/baths, Triclinium, Xystus and two latrines remain independent. Unmapped surrounding courtyard columns/walls, signage and site furniture remain context.
